edges.reason: msg.sender is cast to payable and emitted as the relayer address in MetaTransactionExecuted
userAddress indexes the nonces mapping to read the current nonce
nonces[userAddress].add(1) reads the state variable and increments it
userAddress determines which nonce slot is incremented, so replay protection depends on it
User-controlled functionSignature is concatenated with userAddress and passed as calldata to a low-level call
executeMetaTransaction performs address(this).call on the composed calldata, re-entering the contract
executeMetaTransaction requires verify() to authenticate the signer before executing
hashMetaTransaction output is wrapped into the typed message hash consumed by ecrecover in verify
signer argument of verify is the userAddress supplied by the caller and checked against ecrecover
The in-memory metaTx struct is hashed by hashMetaTransaction
_msgSender override delegates to ContextMixin.msgSender
msgSender returns msg.sender when the caller is not the contract itself
AdminMintTo calls _safeMint to create the token
The _to parameter is the recipient passed to _safeMint
currentTokenId local is assigned _nextTokenId.current() in AdminMintTo
currentTokenId is passed as the minted token id
_nextTokenId state variable supplies the value of currentTokenId
The counter state variable is mutated by the unchecked += 1 in increment()
amount parameter bounds the minting loop in AdminMintMultipleTo
The loop driven by amount repeatedly calls _safeMint
_safeMint triggers an external onERC721Received callback on contract recipients
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external receiver call after state changes
_safeMint validates the recipient through _checkOnERC721Received
_transfer updates _balances with -= and += operations
_transfer rewrites the _owners mapping for the token id
_burn decrements the owner balance in _balances
AdminTransferFromTo calls the internal _transfer
AdminTransferFromToMultiple loops calling _transfer over caller-supplied arrays
_mint writes the new owner into the _owners mapping
AdminSetProxyAddress writes the proxyRegistryAddress state variable
The _proxyRegistryAddress parameter is assigned to proxyRegistryAddress
isApprovedForAll reads proxyRegistryAddress to query whitelisted proxy contracts
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner through _transferOwnership
transferOwnership is onlyOwner restricted and reassigns the owner state variable
renounceOwnership clears the owner state variable
AdminPause sets the _paused state variable to true
AdminSetTokenURI writes the TokenURI state variable
totalSupply reads _nextTokenId and subtracts one
getNonce returns the value stored in the nonces mapping for the user
AdminBurn calls the internal _burn
